evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/ai-chat/components/ChatInterface.tsx:48 — `const sendMessage = useSendMessage(currentSessionId || '')` binds the mutation to the session id captured at render time.

ChatInterface.tsx:93-120 handleSendMessage: when there is no current session, it awaits createSession, calls setCurrentSessionId(session.id), then `setTimeout(async () => { await sendMessage.mutateAsync({ content }) }, 100)`. The setTimeout closes over the SAME sendMessage instance from this render, which is still bound to the empty session id (currentSessionId was null). setCurrentSessionId does not update the already-captured mutation, so the first message of a brand-new chat POSTs to `/ai/chat/sessions//messages` (empty session id) — the happy-path first message silently fails/404s. The 100ms setTimeout is also a timing race (code comment admits: 'This is a simplified version - in production you'd want better state management'). Fix: pass the freshly-created session id into the send call (e.g. useSendMessage taking sessionId as a mutate arg, or call the API with the returned session.id directly) and drop the setTimeout.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/ai-chat/components/ChatInterface.tsx:61-141 — createSession (New chat), deleteSession, and messageFeedback failures are caught with empty `catch {}` blocks commented '// Error handling is managed by mutation', but the only error UI rendered is `sendMessage.isError` (ChatInterface.tsx:254-258). A failed 'New chat' (createSession) or 'Delete session' (deleteSession) therefore produces NO user-facing error — the action silently does nothing. Completeness gap: there is no isError branch or toast for createSession.isError / deleteSession.isError, contradicting the swallowing comments. Add user-visible error states (or route these through the shared Toast) for the create/delete mutations.
